correspondences.notes: Holds images or masks of any technique; BIDS micr accepts .tif but needs the technique suffix.

brainlife.desc: 3D microscopy image or segmentation mask as a single (multi-page or BigTIFF) .tif/.tiff file.
brainlife.name: neuro/tiff-volume

original.desc: 3D volumetric microscopy image or segmentation mask stored as a single (optionally multi-page/BigTIFF) .tif/.tiff file.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Segmentation masks for validation against ground truth.

**Not for:** Data needing physical voxel size; plain TIFF may not record it.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.tiff-volume.json

identifying_risks: Specimen IDs in TIFF tags may link to a donor.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 2: human status depends on the specimen; participant-level tissue images carry no direct identifiers (Tier 2), non-human data is Tier 1.
sharing_cautions: Confirm species and donor consent terms before sharing human tissue images.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 when the specimen is non-human (e.g. mouse) or synthetic.
Tier 2 for human tissue linked to a donor or specimen code.

intended_use: Segmentation masks for validation against ground truth.
not_suitable_for: Data needing physical voxel size; plain TIFF may not record it.
